result_summary: Recovered Prometeo móvil as a logical swarm surface over the already-served single Universal Host, not as an independently evidenced mobile application or catalog page. Separated V5 Served byte authority, current product behavior/platform registry, candidate contracts/sources and retired historical shell lineage; recorded authority-granularity mismatches without promoting or rewriting them.

acceptance_matrix.criterion: current vs candidate vs historical truth separated
at least one non-obvious finding or explicit no-finding
next work deduplicated against active queues

key_findings: prometeo-mobile is a logical swarm surface_id and no catalog page_id of that name was found; its evidenced loop resolves through the root Universal Host and page-scoped Change Threads.
shared/universal-shell/v5/SERVED_MANIFEST.json is the explicit byte-level Served authority for current V5; the publisher validates and live-probes https://juanmanuelpm.github.io/prometeo/.
SINGLE_SHELL_HOST_CONTRACT_v1 remains CANDIDATE_RELEASE_GATE even though manifested V5 serves several of its behaviors; no contract status was changed.
CURRENT_GRAPH revision 17 still points served_current to an older P3 visible-product-set; this was recorded as registry lag/different authority granularity, not overwritten.
The served source itself lives under a candidate/ directory, demonstrating that exact lifecycle authority outranks filename/path inference.
shared/prometeo-shell/v2 is a retired no-UI compatibility stub; its former implementation is recoverable from blob 94f89e21c2bda4e0cc038b55ee77daa2d6b4130f.

deduplication.reason: All obvious follow-up classes are already claimed or prepared; emitting another would duplicate/fill.
